offering_description.value: SunOpta makes plant-based beverages, fruit snacks, nutritional beverages, and broths for retailers, food and beverage brands, and foodservice operators. It manufactures private-label and branded products and uses aseptic processing to package shelf-stable beverages.

primary_products.value: plant-based milks; plant-based creamers; fruit snacks; nutritional beverages; broths and stocks

primary_services.value: private-label and contract manufacturing; product formulation; aseptic processing and packaging

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery retailers, food and beverage brands, and foodservice operators; B2C: shoppers buying branded plant-based beverages through retailers

end_markets.value: grocery retail; packaged foods and beverages; foodservice; nutritional beverages

revenue_model.value: product sales: finished beverages, fruit snacks, and broths sold to retail and foodservice customers; project or contract: manufacturing and packaging products to retailers’ and food brands’ specifications

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes plant ingredients and other food inputs into packaged products for retailers, brands, and foodservice operators

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with most operations in the United States

specialization.value: related lines: plant-based milks and creamers, fruit snacks, nutritional beverages, and broths

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: grocery chains, food and beverage brands, and foodservice accounts; third-party retail: grocery stores carrying company-branded and private-label products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety, preventive controls, and labeling rules for packaged foods and beverages

notes: Sales coverage outside North America is uncertain.
